items.notes: Go host lifecycle exists; Chromium renderer, utility, and crash process parity is not implemented.
Electron app API must match events, lifecycle semantics, single instance behavior, paths, and platform quirks.
Requires native Chromium window bridge and option/event parity.
Requires navigation, frames, DevTools, capture, printing, preload, permissions, and event parity.
Router exists; JS binding, structured clone behavior, frame routing, and security constraints are pending.
Must cover sessions, cookies, cache, permissions, protocol handlers, and network service behavior.
Must match Electron 42 defaults and all supported combinations.
Requires embedded Node 24.15.0 and ABI compatibility.
Must cover ASAR, packaging, autoUpdater, crashReporter, signing/notarization expectations, and platform outputs.
Benchmark harness exists; no speed claims are valid until official Electron and Electron-Go runs are recorded.
